svg.aria-label: The delivery date house rule from the SOP, line by line. The default lead time of five calendar days is the company choice and Business Central does not enforce it. The order date is today, taken from the computer clock, never from an earlier draft. A default is offered and the person confirms it. The date is saved in the requestedDeliveryDate field so it shows on the order.
svg.text: One house rule in the SOP
